what_it_means: Money that has arrived but has not yet been given a job. The single most prominent number in the app.
where_it_appears: Budget header. Also a docs page title.
translator_note: 'Reste à affecter' is the more idiomatic accounting phrasing but longer. Confirm which reads better in a header.

what_it_means: To give money a job by moving it into a category.
where_it_appears: Primary action verb throughout the budget screen.
translator_note: 'Assigner' is also possible; 'affecter' is the budgeting convention.

what_it_means: Budget grid column: how much money was put into this category this month.
where_it_appears: Budget table column header. One of the core three (Assigned / Activity / Available).

what_it_means: Budget grid column: money that moved in or out of this category this month.
Budget grid column: what is actually left to spend in this category right now.
where_it_appears: Budget table column header. The number users check most.

what_it_means: An envelope that holds money for a purpose (Groceries, Rent).
A collapsible heading that groups related categories.
where_it_appears: Budget screen structure. Docs page title.

what_it_means: The plan for a month, and also the top-level container users can have several of.
The method: every unit of currency gets a job until nothing is unassigned.
The cash-in-envelopes metaphor Budgero digitizes.
where_it_appears: Marketing and docs. High SEO value in German.

what_it_means: A category whose Available has gone negative.
A real-world place money sits (checking, savings, credit card).
where_it_appears: Sidebar, docs page title. NOTE: distinct from a user login account — check context before translating.

what_it_means: An account whose balance feeds Ready to Assign.
An account tracked for net worth but excluded from budgeting.
where_it_appears: Account settings. Inbound transfers from these credit Ready to Assign.

what_it_means: A single movement of money.
Who money went to, or came from.
where_it_appears: Transaction table column, transaction form field.

what_it_means: Money coming in.
Money going out.
A transaction confirmed against the real account.
translator_note: Standard French accounting term for reconciled-against-statement.

what_it_means: A transaction entered but not yet confirmed against the real account.
To confirm the app balance matches the real account balance.
Movement of money between two of the user's own accounts.
One transaction divided across multiple categories.
translator_note: 'Ventilée' is the accounting term for split-across-accounts.

what_it_means: A funding plan attached to a category. Four types across spending and savings flavors.
where_it_appears: Docs page title, category detail. NOTE: distinct from 'target' — a goal HAS a target.

what_it_means: The number a goal is aiming at. A parameter OF a goal, not a synonym for goal.
The date a savings goal should be reached by.
What a goal requires to stay on track this month.
An automation that acts on matching transactions.
The subsystem that evaluates and applies rules.
A transaction scheduled to repeat.
Total assets minus total liabilities.
translator_note: 'Valeur nette' is the literal calque; 'patrimoine net' is the native financial term.

what_it_means: Following loan and credit-card balances down to zero.
A container holding budgets, shareable with other users.
The password that derives the encryption key. Cannot be recovered — distinct from the login password.
where_it_appears: Docs page title, onboarding, security settings.

what_it_means: The server cannot read user data. Core product claim.
where_it_appears: Marketing, security docs. High value in the German market.

what_it_means: Data encrypted on device, never readable server-side.
Running Budgero on your own infrastructure.
Full functionality without a network connection.
Bringing transactions in from a CSV file.
A saved analytical view over transactions.
A what-if projection over the budget.
A tracked product warranty with an expiry.
Giving another user access to a budget.
Support for accounts and budgets in different currencies.
where_it_appears: Docs page title, marketing. Key differentiator for the EU market.
